description: Retrieve an existing VisualSpec workflow by jobId or visualId, returning the spec, SVG layout, and Mermaid diagram.

authToken.description: Optional session token (`utok_...`) if not passed via Authorization header.

id.description: The jobId or visualId of the workflow to retrieve

includeExcalidraw.description: Explicitly include or omit inline Excalidraw scene JSON (defaults to true only for 'full').

includeSvg.description: Explicitly include or omit inline SVG XML (defaults to true for 'full' and 'svg', false for 'preview'/'compact'/'mermaid').

maxPreviewHeight.description: Target preview height bound in px for responsive preview metadata (default 900).

maxPreviewWidth.description: Target preview width bound in px for responsive preview metadata (default 1200).

renderFormat.description: Optional output size control (defaults to 'full'). Use 'preview' for compact metadata + svgUrl + mermaid without large inline Excalidraw/SVG blobs, or 'svg'/'mermaid' for a single format.

name: get_workflow
title: Get Compiled Workflow
